title: Stimulating Your Nervous System for Calm (SYNC) Study
official: Stimulating Your Nervous System for Calm (SYNC) Study
summary: The goal of this feasibility clinical trial is to learn whether a two-week program involving gentle stimulation of the vagus nerve at the ear (taVNS) is practical and acceptable for healthy young adults. The study will also evaluate whether collecting information about heart rate patterns and well-being is feasible during the program. If this study is feasible and acceptable, the research team will conduct a larger study to see if taVNS alone or in combination with listening to audio instructions is helpful for individuals in terms of mental and physical health.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* 18 years to 29 years old
* fluent in English
* non-pregnant female participants using effective contraception
* participants with baseline Root Mean Square of Successive Differences (RMSSD, a measure of the variation in time between consecutive heartbeats) within 1 SD below the mean identified by Tegenge et al (2020): Women Men Age Bin Mean Mean- 1SD Mean Mean- 1SD 15-19\* 73.8 23.3 70.8. 22 20-24 64.7 17.4 57.3 17.2 25-29 58.0 18 52.1 13.3 \*Only individuals \>18 years old are eligible, but the 15-19 age bin will be used for participants falling in this age range.

Exclusion Criteria:

* taking medication for psychiatric, cardiovascular or chronic inflammatory condition (e.g., rheumatoid arthritis)
* used recreational drugs within past 2 weeks
* history of serious mental health conditions (including schizophrenia, other psychotic disorder, bipolar disorder, or severe major depressive disorder), cardiovascular disease, or neurological disease
* skin irritation at stimulation sites
* pregnant women
* engaged in meditation more than 4 times in the past two weeks
* adults unable to consent
* prisoners
* students for whom the investigator have direct access to or influence on their grades
